Name: Preferred Pet Breed GSQ and CP Token
Author: Delatrix
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Provides additional ways for mod authors to query against their preferred pet's breed by adding a new [font=Courier New]PLAYER_PREFERRED_PETBREED[/font] Game State Query and a new [font=Courier New]PreferredPetBreed[/font] Content Patcher token. [/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]([b]Mod Authors: [/b]See the Stardew Modding Wiki on [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Game_state_queries]Game State Queries[/url] and the Content Patcher [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/tokens.md#mod-provided-tokens]token[/url] guide for more details on using game state queries and tokens.)[/color][/size]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] are installed[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*][b]For players:[/b] Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*][b]For mod authors:[/b] See Setup and Usage section below for how to use this new GSQ and CP token with your mod[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Setup and Usage for Mod Authors:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Setup:[/b][/size]
[b]For mod authors:[/b] [size=3][color=#D4D4D8]To use this game state query or token with your own Content Patcher mod, ensure you do AT LEAST ONE OF the following:[/color][/size]
  1. Add 'Delatrix.PetBreedQueryAndToken ' to your mod's manifest.json as a dependency:     
[code]"Dependencies": [  { "UniqueID": "Delatrix.PetBreedQueryAndToken", "IsRequired": true }  ][/code]  2. OR Ensure the patch using the token has an immutable (i.e. not using any tokens) HasMod condition which lists the mod ANY time it is referenced. Example:
[code]{
   "Format": "2.9.0",
   "Changes": [
      {
         "Action": "EditData",
         "Target": "Characters/Dialogue/Marnie",
         "Entries": {
            "gotPet": "I hope you and your pet {{Delatrix.PetBreedQueryAndToken/PreferredPetBreed}} are getting along!",
         },
         "When": {
            "HasMod": "Delatrix.PetBreedQueryAndToken"
         }
      }
   ]
}[/code]

[size=4][b][font=Courier New]PreferredPetBreed[/font] Content Patcher Token Usage:[/b][/size]
  Like in the example above, every time you wish to reference this mod's token, you MUST pre-pend it with the ModId like so:
[code]// Inline string usage:
"What a lovely pet {{Delatrix.PetBreedQueryAndToken/PreferredPetBreed}} you have!"

// Condition usage for "When" (i.e. you have another mod that adds a custom 'GermanShepard' pet breed):
"Changes": [
{
    "Action": "EditData",
    "Target": "Characters/Dialogue/Marnie",
    "Entries": {
      "gotPet": "I hope you and your pet German Shepard are getting along!",
    },
    "When": {
      "Delatrix.PetBreedQueryAndToken/PreferredPetBreed": "GermanShepard"
    }
  }
][/code]

[b][size=4][font=Courier New]PLAYER_PREFERRED_PETBREED[/font] Game State Query Usage:[/size][/b]
[b]For mod authors:[/b] To utilize the new game state query, use the following syntax (similar to vanilla PREFERRED_PLAYER_PET query):
[code]Delatrix.PLAYER_PREFERRED_PETBREED <player> <pet breed>+[/code]IMPORTANT NOTE: You are REQUIRED to put Delatrix. before the query!


Example (i.e. you have another mod that adds a custom 'GermanShepard' pet breed):
[code]// Will check if the preferred pet breed of the current player is a German Shepard
"Condition": "Delatrix.PLAYER_PREFERRED_PETBREED Current GermanShepard"[/code]This PLAYER_PREFERRED_PETBREED query also accepts multiple pet breeds as input (like vanilla PLAYER_PREFERRED_PET), separated by spaces. Example:
[code]// Will check if the preferred pet breed of the current player is a German Shepard OR Siberian Husky
"Condition": "Delatrix.PLAYER_PREFERRED_PETBREED Current GermanShepard SiberianHusky"[/code]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to be of any use.[/color][/size]

[size=5][b]See Also[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]See Pathoschild's Content Patcher [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/tokens.md#mod-provided-tokens]author guide for mod-provided tokens[/url] for additional details and tips[/color][/size]
